title: Stallone Wants Schwarzenegger to Lead a Tulsa King Spinoff
excerpt:
Stallone has floated an idea for an Arnold-led series.
No such project has been officially announced.
body_md:
In an interview with Cigar Aficionado, Sylvester Stallone expressed interest in expanding Tulsa King with a series led by Arnold Schwarzenegger. He imagines his former rival and current friend playing a separate character who could cross paths with his own, recalling their collaboration in The Expendables.

Stallone hopes Schwarzenegger will agree. However, no such project has been announced at any stage of development. Paramount+ and producer 101 Studios had no immediate comment.

Tulsa King already has a spinoff in Frisco King, starring Samuel L. Jackson. An Arnold-led series could expand that universe further, but no title, premise or casting agreement has been established.

Stallone also recalled disagreeing with John G. Avildsen over the direction of Rocky II, rejecting a proposed departure from Rocky's relationship with Adrian and established personality.

He expressed doubts about returning as Rocky himself and discussed a potential prequel involving younger versions of Rocky and Mickey. That, too, remains an idea rather than an announced production.
